name: Good Morning, Dictator
source:
While the country is being ravaged by civil unrest, its Dictator appears on a morning show. During “Breakfast With Tobhy” a renown host by the name of Tobhias Tobiakov asks the Dictator to share his childhood memories. Join them on the Dictator’s journey down the memory lane, where he will reminisce on his (ab)normal family, juvenile conflicts, and first love, and decide if he is indeed a Dictator, or a DICKtator after all.

[From [url=https://surplus-deficitus.itch.io/good-morning-dictator]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当这个国家正遭受内乱的蹂躏时，其独裁者却出现在早间节目中。在“与托比共进早餐”节目中，一位名叫托比亚斯·托比亚科夫的著名主持人请独裁者分享他的童年记忆。与他们一起踏上独裁者的记忆之旅，在那里他将回忆他的（不正常）家庭、青少年冲突和初恋，并决定他是否确实是一个独裁者，或者到底是一个独裁者。

[来自[url=https://surplus-deficitus.itch.io/good-morning-dictator]Itch.io[/url]]
